Title: Zeitschrift für Kirchengeschichte, Band VII (1885) (containing H. Haupt, Beiträge zur Geschichte der Sekte vom freien Geiste und des Beghardentums, p. 503 ff.)
Creator: Journal volume; the article is by Herman Haupt (1854-1935).
Publisher: Gotha: Friedrich Andreas Perthes (title as printed in the series); this scan: W. Kohlhammer, Stuttgart (host record)
Publication Date: 1885
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: the contents page in the OCR lists 'BAND 7' and the article by Haupt at p. 503; the item record gives 1885 and carries the Public Domain Mark 1.0 licence (creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/).
Language: deu (mixed: German with Latin passages)
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_dyUMAAAAIAAJ (archive.org/details/bub_gb_dyUMAAAAIAAJ), full-text file bub_gb_dyUMAAAAIAAJ_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the Library thread, October 2026.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; the OCR text follows unchanged apart from this header. Nothing stripped, normalised, corrected, re-spaced or retyped. Sampled at opening, middle and end: German readable with scattered letter errors (Latin lists of errors legible); the last pages are scan stamps. Whole journal volume kept whole.
Content note: The whole seventh volume of the Zeitschrift für Kirchengeschichte. The relevant article is Haupt's 'Beiträge zur Geschichte der Sekte vom freien Geiste und des Beghardentums' (from p. 503), which discusses and prints the Mainz manuscript's list of the Free Spirit's errors beside the Passau anonymous's list, the inquisitors' template that later depositions follow. Scholarship around hostile texts; the rest of the volume is outside every world.
